_doc: Revert-verify mutants for req 1848dff9-bb2e-43a9-95e7-d917d6cef552 (issue #4347, `cli create-batch`), subject = the batch command. Run from the repo root: python3 -I ~/.claude/bin/mutant-driver.py <this file> after setting `tree` and `subject` to YOUR checkout (both absolute). One mutant per guarantee the command itself carries; the per-item pipeline is create's own planCreate and is locked by create's suites. Expectations written BEFORE the run (§A44).
subject: <ABSOLUTE PATH TO YOUR exocortex CHECKOUT>/packages/cli/src/commands/create-batch.ts

M1_context_built_per_item._note: The loop-in-one-process that the requirement rules out: every item gets fresh services and a fresh read memo, so every scan runs per item.

M2_batch_uids_not_handed_to_wikilink_val._note: Type-preserving: pendingUids stays read, the context gets an empty set. B4b stays green — it is refused either way, which is what makes the pair prove B4 passes BECAUSE of the batch.

M3_all_or_nothing_reduced_to_best_effort._note: Writes the valid items of a batch that has invalid ones.

M5_caller_uid_checks_removed._note: B5a stays green: a malformed uid is refused by the item-shape check, not by checkCallerUids.

M6_body_expanded_like_inline.from: body = { text: item.body as string, source: "file" };
M6_body_expanded_like_inline.to: body = { text: item.body as string, source: "inline" };
M6_body_expanded_like_inline._note: The parity case carries a literal backslash-n; inline expansion turns it into a line break, --body-file does not.

M11_dry_run_writes._note: B6* also run with --dry-run; a write after planning adds no read of an existing file, so they are not expected to redden.
